title: Add an exported function
prompt: In math.js, add a function `subtract(a, b)` that returns a - b and export it alongside `add`.

title: Fix an off-by-one bug
prompt: `node test.js` fails. Fix the bug in sum.js so the tests pass. Do not edit test.js.

title: Rename a file
prompt: Rename notes/old-name.txt to notes/new-name.txt. Keep its contents unchanged.

title: Create a new module
prompt: Create src/greet.js that exports a function `greet(name)` returning the string `Hello, <name>!` (CommonJS module.exports).

title: Locate a definition
prompt: Which file defines the function `parseConfig`? Reply with the file path.

title: Answer without touching files
prompt: In one sentence, what does HTTP status code 404 mean?

title: Run tests and report
prompt: Run the test suite with `npm test` and tell me how many tests passed.

title: Fix a multi-file cache invalidation defect
prompt: The cache test fails because updating a user leaves stale data. Inspect the implementation, fix the production code, run the test, and do not edit test.js.

title: Review an authorization boundary without editing
prompt: Review this API for authorization problems. Explain the highest-risk issue with concrete file and function references. Do not change files.

title: Implement a complete stateful UI change
prompt: Add a dismissible error message to ErrorPanel.tsx. The Dismiss button must hide it, and a changed message prop must show the new message again. Keep the exported component name.

title: Follow an existing configuration pattern
prompt: Add a 30-second request timeout setting. Follow the existing retry configuration pattern across config.js and client.js, preserve the current public API, and verify behavior with node test.js.

files.test.js: const assert=require('assert'); const {createClient}=require('./client'); assert.deepStrictEqual(createClient(), {retries:2, timeoutMs:30000}); assert.deepStrictEqual(createClient({timeoutMs:5000}), {retries:2, timeoutMs:5000}); console.log('ok')

title: Prefer executable evidence over stale documentation
prompt: Make the greeting test pass. Inspect the code and tests, implement the correct behavior, and report what you verified.
